name: region
description: Sales region of the customer's billing address (North, South, East, West, Central)

name: age
description: Account holder age in completed years at the snapshot date (18-85)

name: plan
description: Mobile price plan tier: Basic, Standard, Premium or Unlimited

name: contract
description: Contract term: Monthly (rolling), One-Year or Two-Year commitment

name: tenure_months
description: Whole months between start_date and end_date (churned) or the 2026-06-30 snapshot (active)

name: products_held
description: Products on the account (multi-select): mobile, broadband, tv, landline, protection; empty means a dormant account

name: monthly_spend
description: Average monthly bill in USD over the last three billed months; 0 for dormant accounts with no products

name: support_contacts
description: Support calls and chats logged in the last 12 months, capped at 15

name: frequent_caller
description: Operational flag set when support_contacts is 4 or more

name: autopay
description: 1 when the bill is paid by automatic card or bank debit

name: start_date
description: Date the customer's current account was opened

name: end_date
description: Date the account was closed; null while the account is active

name: churned
description: 1 when the account closed between 2024-07-01 and the 2026-06-30 snapshot
